articles.title: Briton among six killed in 'far-right' shooting in Krakow
articles.description: Police in the Polish city say the attacker randomly fired at people after driving on to Main Market Square.

articles.title: Germans wrestle with what to do with Hitler's destroyed Eagle's Nest retreat
articles.description: While some believe the site should be partially or completely rebuilt, others want it abandoned and all memory of its Nazi past forgotten.

articles.title: Veterans shouldn't sleep rough this Christmas, Burnham says
articles.description: Downing Street says the prime minister will personally write to councils on Armistice Day to urge them to draw up plans.

articles.title: Royal Family join veterans and families at Festival of Remembrance
articles.description: The senior royals attended the annual event at London's Royal Albert Hall on the eve of Remembrance Sunday.
